questions.q: On which date did the Constitution of India come into official effect, celebrated as Republic Day?
Gir National Park in Gujarat is the exclusive home of the endangered _____ lion.
How many regional official languages are displayed on the language panel on the back of Indian currency notes?

Assertion (A): Article 51A of the Indian Constitution makes protecting forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife a Fundamental Duty.
Reason (R): Environmental care is essential for national ecological stability and the survival of future generations.
options: A) Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation.
B) Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation.
C) (A) is true, but (R) is false.
D) (A) is false, but (R) is true.
questions.ans: A) Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation.

questions.q: What core message is conveyed by the ancient Indian philosophy 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam'?
options: B) The world is one family
questions.ans: B) The world is one family
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for 'The world is one family'.

sections.section_name: Section B: Short Answer & Reasoning (10 Marks)

questions.q: Give Reason: Protecting forests and wildlife is included as a Fundamental Duty under Article 51A of our Constitution.
questions.solution: A healthy environment with thriving forests and wildlife maintains ecological balance, air quality, and water security, making natural protection a personal moral duty for every citizen.
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for maintaining ecological balance and water/air security; 1 Mark for personal moral duty of citizenship.

questions.q: How do Indian currency notes physically demonstrate national linguistic unity amidst cultural diversity?
questions.solution: Indian banknotes print the denomination value on a special language panel featuring 15 regional scripts on the back, alongside Hindi and English on the front, representing equal national respect.
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for 15 regional language scripts on language panel; 1 Mark for symbolizing constitutional equality and unity.

questions.q: Give Reason: Local Maldhari pastoralist communities were vital partners in rescuing Asiatic lions in Gir Forest.
questions.solution: Maldharis co-existed alongside lions, shared forest water holes, alerted forest guards about poachers, and tolerated livestock loss, creating a successful community-backed conservation model.
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for co-existence and poacher vigilance; 1 Mark for community-backed wildlife protection model.

questions.q: Explain how regional attire, headgear (turbans, topis, phetas), and festivals enrich India's cultural identity.
questions.solution: Diverse headgear and attire reflect adaptation to regional climate and geography. Celebrating varied harvest festivals under shared national pride weaves rich threads into a unified national fabric.
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for climate/geographic adaptation in attire; 1 Mark for weaving regional traditions into national identity.

questions.q: Differentiate between Fundamental Rights and Fundamental Duties specified in the Indian Constitution.
questions.solution: Fundamental Rights are constitutional guarantees granted to every citizen (like equality and freedom). Fundamental Duties (Article 51A) are civic and environmental responsibilities citizens owe to the nation.
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for defining Rights as constitutional guarantees; 1 Mark for defining Duties as civic/environmental responsibilities.

sections.section_name: Section C: Long Answer, Observation & Application (10 Marks)
sections.question_type: Long Answer / Observation / Diagram / Practical Scenario

questions.q: Explain how the Indian Constitution unites a culturally diverse nation while upholding environmental care. Outline (a) Constitutional adoption milestone, (b) Recognition of diversity, and (c) Three environmental duties under Article 51A.
questions.solution:
1. Constitutional Milestone: Drafted under Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and adopted on 26 January 1950 (Republic Day).
2. Recognition of Diversity: Grants fundamental equality regardless of caste, language, or religion, recognizing 22 official languages.
3. Three Environmental Duties under Article 51A:
   - Protect and improve natural environments like forests, lakes, and rivers.
   - Safeguard wild animals and show compassion for living creatures.
   - Preserve public property and abjure violence.
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for adoption milestone details; 1 Mark for equal constitutional recognition of diversity; 3 Marks for listing 3 environmental duties under Article 51A (1 Mark each).

questions.q: Discuss the conservation success story of the Asiatic lion in Gir National Park, Gujarat. Explain why species endangerment occurs, how forest guards and Maldharis intervened, and why community involvement is essential for wildlife protection.
questions.solution:
1. Species Endangerment Causes: Habitat destruction, poaching, and human-wildlife conflict reduced Asiatic lions to near extinction in the early 20th century.
2. Gir Intervention Measures: Gir was declared a protected National Park. Forest guards patrolled borders, while local Maldhari pastoralists monitored lion movements and shared water sources.
3. Community Involvement Significance: Wildlife sanctuaries cannot succeed by enforcement alone; local community trust and co-existence ensure anti-poaching vigilance and habitat safety.
questions.scheme: 1 Mark for explaining causes of lion endangerment; 2 Marks for describing Gir protection measures by guards and Maldharis; 2 Marks for explaining why community involvement is vital.
